content.short: revoke.cash lets you manage and revoke token allowances to strengthen wallet security.
content.description: Revoke.cash, launched by Rosco Kalis in 2019, helps users control and revoke token allowances, creating a barrier between their wallets and the Web3 DApp ecosystem that handles tokens and NFT assets on their behalf. Developers can implement vaults to safely keep smart contract assets by requiring explicit approval steps before allowances run automatically, giving users more oversight and protection in how contracts access their funds and tokens.
